Incident Receiver Resource Get Incident Receiver Server
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/incidentReceiverServers/:incidentReceiverServerId

Gets DLP Incident Receiver information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
incidentReceiverServerId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the Incident Receiver.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for the Incident Receiver.

name
string
REQUIRED

The Incident Receiver server name.

url
string
REQUIRED

The Incident Receiver server URL.

status
string
REQUIRED

The status of the Incident Receiver.

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED, DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_PROVIDER, NOT_PROVISIONED_IN_SERVICE_PROVIDER]

flags
int32

The Incident Receiver server flag.
